findings.title: Deadline recovery can return ROLLED_BACK while a forward mutation is still running
findings.observation: Resolved. Deadline expiry aborts the oracle context, but the controller awaits the oracle Promise before it can enter recovery. The hard-stop race is gone, and nested Docker calls receive the actor signal.
findings.trigger: Hold a forward operation past its AbortSignal and let it mutate before settling.
findings.impact: The actor now quiesces before rollback; the journal cannot return ROLLED_BACK while that actor can still mutate.

evidence.description: runOracle requests cancellation and unconditionally awaits the oracle ownership boundary before recovery.
RunDocker accepts AbortSignal, defaultDocker passes it to execFile, and active execution provides it through AsyncLocalStorage.
The exact ignored-signal regression requires abort-requested, forward-actor-quiescent, rollback and proves no later mutation.
Four delayed restore mutation classes remain inside the actor fence and leave zero resources after terminal delay.

findings.remediation: Completed at the current head: cancellation reaches nested Docker children and terminal recovery joins the forward oracle.
findings.verification: All 64 LP-05 tests pass; the prior ignored-abort trigger completes before the one rollback and produces no post-terminal side effect.

findings.title: Restore cleanup can be recorded before an in-flight Compose operation creates resources
findings.observation: Resolved. Restore mutations are owned by the joined oracle; cleanup persists QUIESCING, removes exact labelled generations, and requires multiple empty observations before CLEANED.
findings.trigger: Delay restore resource creation across deadline cancellation and make it appear after cleanup's first empty observation.
findings.impact: The late generation is observed and reaped before CLEANED; no isolated restore resource remains after terminal return.

evidence.description: Restore cleanup persists QUIESCING and samples until the required consecutive empty count is met.
All restore execution occurs inside the actor signal context, and rollback cleanup runs only after the execution Promise settles.
A resource generation appearing after the first empty observation is discovered, label-checked, removed and followed by two empty samples.
Delayed Compose creation, migration, app startup and story replay each quiesce before rollback clears the resource set.

findings.remediation: Completed at the current head: join restore actors before cleanup and require the persisted quiescence fence before CLEANED.
findings.verification: The late-generation and four restore-stage regressions pass, production/backup cleanup authority remains unchanged, and the full exact-head LP-05 suite is green.
